name: Wallet disagreement resolution
hypothesis: Buy after prior seller cohorts stop reducing inventory and buyer cohorts retain net purchases above the trigger.
data: complete prior wallet fills and fees
spec: Setup: A new consensus may form after qualified wallets initially trade opposite sides. Entry: Buy after prior seller cohorts stop reducing inventory and buyer cohorts retain net purchases above the trigger. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit when qualified selling resumes or the resolution range fails. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs labelled wallet histories (on-chain, not connected)
